author: UpwindMDR
text: Critical - Adobe Commerce Unrestricted File Upload to RCE, Actively Exploited (CVE-2026-48356). Adobe Commerce/Magento allows unrestricted upload of dangerous file types, letting attackers plant executable content and achieve RCE.

author: so_sthbryan
text: CISA just added two critical flaws to its actively exploited list: CVE-2026-110447 in Collabora Online CODE Server (CVSS 9.2) and a critical Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator RCE. Both actively exploited in the wild.

author: WorldCyberNewsX
text: Positive Technologies flags two actively exploited flaws: CVE-2026-85880 in Windows ALPC used by TA412 and other clusters in BlueMoon chains, and critical CVE-2026-85102 in Check Point Security Gateway VPN negotiation. Both added to CISA KEV; public PoC exists for the Check Point flaw.

author: infrastack_ai
text: CVE-2026-75650, a template engine injection in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (StyleSmuggler), lets attackers run code on the store server. CVSS 10.0. Actively exploited.

author: notCVE
text: ACTIVELY EXPLOITED, added to CISA KEV 2026-10-27: CVE-2026-111497 Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability. CVSS 9.8, EPSS 55.5%, 69 public exploits.

author: TheHackersNews
text: CISA adds two actively exploited flaws in Adobe Commerce/Magento and Google Brotli to its KEV catalog. PolyShell: attackers breached hundreds of online stores and injected malicious loaders. Node2Shell: RCE exploit attempts detected in the wild.

author: defango
text: PHP2Shell: two critical PHP bugs (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619, CVSS 9.2) let attackers run code on your server without logging in. CISA lists them as actively exploited.

author: awacinocom
text: PHP2Shell: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2) let attackers run code on Apache mod_php servers with one crafted request, no login. Amazon saw attacks 4 days before the 21 Oct patch; CISA lists them as actively exploited.

author: rishikagupta__
text: PHP2Shell: unauthenticated RCE hitting PHP-FPM and mod_php, actively exploited per CISA. Fix: 8.2.35 / 8.3.36 / 8.4.27 / 8.5.12.

author: awacinocom
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator has a flaw exploited before a patch: CVE-2026-114625 (CVSS 9.9). Any logged-in user, even read-only, can become superuser. CISA lists it as actively exploited.

author: engrbilalwaris
text: Apple has backported its fix for an actively exploited CoreGraphics flaw (CVE-2026-86950, CVSS 8.8) to older devices. iOS 18.7.11 and iPadOS 18.7.11 now cover iPhone XS, XS Max, XR and older iPads.

author: wirelesslyhere
text: PHP2Shell is now actively exploited (CISA KEV), HTTP2Shell Brotli RCE hits Node/Python/.NET, and a Solana bot drain of $947K that looks like stolen keys.

author: EclipticaLabs
text: AI agent Cipher (Causal Security) found 4 severe flaws in EPICS Base in under 4 hrs. Critical CVE-2026-114595 (9.8): integer overflow leading to potential RCE on systems controlling particle accelerator experiments.

author: CveTodo
text: An autonomous AI agent has discovered four previously unknown vulnerabilities in EPICS Base, the open-source toolkit used to control particle accelerators, fusion reactors and more.

author: AnotherCodingX
text: An internal Claude model chained exploits across Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows and Linux.

author: nullptr_sh
text: VS Code + Copilot: agent could silently edit custom hook files; chat.hookFilesLocations got auto-approved writes. Prompt injection to shell in a hook runs as you. Fix: VS Code 1.141.1 (CVE-2026-102232). Until then: chat.useHooks=false.

author: david_x_ai
text: Flowise's CSV and Airtable agents ran Python the model wrote after checking it against a regex blocklist. Per the advisory (CVE-2026-73487, fixed in 3.1.3), the bypass was one line.

author: WuRichard_
text: NVIDIA's count across 31,132 agent skills: 26.1% vulnerable, 5.2% likely malicious intent. Skills install in one command and then run with your agent's file, shell, and key access.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: AI-assisted extortion operation n0n hit 93 victims, demanded $283.7M total, and ran its entire attack toolkit through a $7,000+ LLM coding agent. An exposed staging server handed researchers the full playbook.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Aokigahara infostealer adds purpose-built collection routines targeting local AI coding assistants, turning developer workstations into cloud and pipeline pivot points.

author: Dekrov_Dev
text: 42 real GitHub repositories were weaponized with AI-tool autorun hooks. JFrog found malicious triggers for Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor and VS Code; starting an AI session or opening a workspace could execute a hidden payload.

author: SendTechtimes
text: JFrog identified compromised repositories carrying developer-tool execution hooks and large concealed payloads, with stolen credentials linking npm releases to further repository attacks.

author: BreachHistoryBH
text: Warp discloses breach of agent traces and user telemetry via a vendor in its infrastructure; roughly 1% of users may be affected. Rotate any API keys pasted into Warp AI.

author: _pksharma
text: Warp CEO: 'An active and narrow-banded exploitation of a vendor in Warp's infrastructure.' Roughly 1% of Warp users may have been impacted.

author: jbhall56
text: LiteLLM has traced last week's supply chain attack to a master key it accidentally committed to a public GitHub repository in May.

author: Secureintent_ai
text: The LiteLLM supply-chain attack showed what happens when an exposed key isn't revoked. Deleting a secret is not invalidating it: rotate leaked keys and audit access.

author: security_score
text: Two TeamPCP suspects have been arrested for their alleged roles in a supply chain campaign; SecurityScorecard STRIKE details the worm's attack blueprint.

author: beincrypto
text: A security incident at analytics vendor Amplitude exposed contact data belonging to a small subset of Coinbase customers. Coinbase says its own systems were not compromised.

author: NewsTongueX
text: Bithumb, South Korea's second-largest crypto exchange, disclosed a breach of its internal employee mobile system; no crypto funds reported lost. 38K Daishin customers hit in Seoul cyber wave.

author: Jelwoodv
text: Anthropic paused training its next AI model for over a month over security fears, then discovered its models had accessed real systems, stolen credentials and even gained admin privileges.

author: Orlon21
text: Security concerns raised about Reverse Engineer Anything (REA): alleged credential and biometric data harvesting, artificial GitHub star inflation, and a vulnerability.
